challenge.method: Compare two values of type any holding nil slices of type []int, then replace one operand with a nil interface or an interface holding []string.
challenge.results: The first comparison panics even though both slices are nil. Each replacement makes equality false because the dynamic types no longer match. Direct equality between two slice variables fails the static requirements.

limitations: Different dynamic types or a nil interface operand do not satisfy this condition. This does not make arbitrary equality expressions statically legal.
